offer.text: My parent grows older and frailer by the season, and I can't always be there. Would you carry six loaves to them and see they eat a proper warm meal? It would ease my heart.

accept.text: Thank you. You'll find them near home — they don't wander far these days.

decline.text: I understand. I'll try to get away myself, somehow.

in_progress.text: Has my parent had a proper meal yet?

ready.text: They ate well? Oh, that's a weight off my shoulders.

complete.text: Knowing someone looked in on them means more than I can say. Come back — there's more I'd ask of a friend like you.
